thread.title: Hamilton County's 513Relief Bus to visit Anderson Township on June 9
thread.title_full: Hamilton County's 513Relief Bus to visit Anderson Township on June 9

author: Buckeye Reporter
title: Hamilton County's 513Relief Bus to visit Anderson Township on June 9
text:
The Hamilton County 513Relief Bus will be in Anderson Township on May 21, offering access to health screenings, social services, and economic relief. The bus will be available from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Anderson Township Senior Center located at 7970 Beechmont Ave.
The event is open to all members of the community and aims to provide mobile medical service options as well as connections to various community services. Organizers say that the bus acts as a one-stop resource for residents seeking support in several areas.
According to the announcement, “Services include mobile and medical service options, and plus connections to numerous community services, and all in the community are welcome.”
The initiative is part of Hamilton County’s ongoing efforts to make essential services more accessible through mobile outreach programs. Community members are encouraged to learn more about upcoming stops by visiting 513Relief.org .
The bus is sponsored by Hamilton County.
